items.title: FSB consults on principles for regulatory and supervisory modernisation
items.grounded_note: The FSB proposed eight high-level principles intended to make financial regulation and supervision more effective, risk-focused, coherent and responsive to changing vulnerabilities, technologies and market conditions. The cross-sector consultation is relevant to insurance supervisors and internationally active insurers; comments are due on 8 January 2027.

items.title: Taiwan FSC consults on safe use of agentic AI by financial institutions
items.grounded_note: The FSC issued a 30-day consultation document covering governance, risk classification and security controls for financial institutions deploying agentic AI. It addresses risks including unauthorized tool use, sensitive-data leakage and cascading errors, and may inform subsequent guidance and supervisory communication applicable to insurers.

items.title: Taiwan FSC strengthens fair-treatment assessment and remediation framework
items.grounded_note: The FSC reported changes to its financial-sector fair-treatment assessment, which covered 20 life insurers and 19 property insurers. The framework adds supervisory and examination findings as a deduction factor and introduces improvement plans and targeted supervisory counselling for firms ranked in the bottom 20% for two consecutive years. AIA Taiwan was identified among the recipients of a most-improved award.

items.title: Mainland China NFRA consults on comprehensive revision of the Insurance Law
items.grounded_note: The NFRA published a draft comprehensive revision of the PRC Insurance Law, with comments due on October 3, 2026. The 214-article draft addresses areas including look-through shareholder supervision, related-party obligations, stronger penalties and consumer protection, risk resolution and market exit. Publication predates the requested window, but the consultation deadline falls within it.
